title: Rav Natan bar Asya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Pesachim 52a relates that he went from Bei Rav—Dikdukei Soferim reads “from Biram”—to Pumbedita on the second festival day of Shavuot. Rav Yosef excommunicated him. The Rif and Dikdukei Soferim read Mar Natan Asya.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman prints Pesachim 52a (נב.). He reports travel on the second day of Shavuot and excommunication by Rav Yosef. The supplied form שאול is understood contextually as a travel verb; the Hebrew letters remain unchanged.
מבירם means “from Biram,” an alternative to Bei Rav, not a place named Mavirom. Hyman attributes this reading to דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim.
Hyman reports Mar Natan Asya in the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim, differing from the heading in title and by omitting bar. The heading’s full Rav and the cited Mar are both preserved.
